capabilities: Display and manage vault tasks on a timeline
Read and write Obsidian Tasks-format task lines (dates, priorities, recurrence)
Repair malformed recurrence rules left by earlier plugin versions
Expose tasks to AI agents through a built-in MCP server
Create and edit tasks via AI providers and voice input
extras: The built-in MCP server uses bearer-token auth by default and lists its tools, resources and prompts; AI requests go through Obsidian's requestUrl, cannot be cancelled, and arrive unstreamed. Detailed instructions cover repairing malformed recurrence lines written by versions up to 0.3.0.
intentEvidence: It is a continuation of obsidian-tasks-calendar-wrapper
problem: Obsidian has no timeline view for tasks, and hand-editing Tasks-format lines with dates, recurrence and other fields is error-prone.

relations.evidence: It is a continuation of obsidian-tasks-calendar-wrapper, based on tasks-timeline-components
